stateNotes.implementedLocal: The current source consumes the accepted DApp Connect SDK for EIP-6963/EIP-1193 Standard Wallet discovery, prefers YNX Wallet, offers MetaMask and the official YNX Wallet download, and keeps the approved 0x account on YNX Testnet 0x1917 separate from private Product Session state. Guest/public preview works without a Wallet. Private objects, uploads, sharing, AI context and deletion fail closed because Product Session v2 is not active; no local or canned session is created. The existing bounded Cloud control plane, product-isolated metadata and bytes, versioning, lifecycle, recovery, SDK, erasure and observability source remain present. The Cloud container is product-isolated, non-root, read-only and capability-dropped. This does not claim production object storage, Product Session v2, installed-client success, public deployment of this source, production signing or store release.
